Realistic anatomy.

Back mostly facing the camera.

Flared skirt moving softly with the walking motion.

CAMERA:
Vertical 3:4 composition.
Authentic handheld iPhone perspective.

Medium-close rear framing.

Feet and lower legs cropped out of the frame.
Subject large in the frame.
Camera positioned directly behind the subject.
Natural smartphone perspective.

LIGHTING:
Bright natural midday sunlight.
Realistic shadows and highlights.

DETAILS:
Natural flare and movement of the skirt.
Realistic woven bag texture.
Authentic everyday candid atmosphere.

NEGATIVE / CONSTRAINTS:
No CGI.
No illustration.
No anime.
No plastic skin.
